heroes.name: Seraphiel
heroes.title: the Choir Eternal
heroes.bio: The last seraph who still sings the hymn that once held the sky together. Every note is a sunrise; every chorus, a judgment.
heroes.look: Statuesque, voluptuous six-winged seraph goddess (two large pairs, one small pair at the head), golden sunray halo crown, very long platinum hair, serene closed-eye half-smile. Glossy white highleg leotard split by a center opening to the navel and laced with gold filigree chains, open back, long white drapes from the hips over the leotard, flowing sleeves, gold body chains, anklets, bare feet. One hand raised to a floating golden tuning-fork sceptre. The poster goddess.

ultimate.name: Hymn of Judgment
ultimate.description: Sings the sky's final verse: 180% ATK to all enemies and Stuns them for 1.5 s.

passives.name: Radiant Aria
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to Stun the target for 1 s.

heroes.name: Cassiel
heroes.title: Aegis of Dawn
heroes.bio: Captain of the Gate Wardens. She has never taken a step backward, and she does not intend to start.
heroes.look: Athletic, curvy paladin angel with toned abs, short silver bob and a cocky smirk. Ornate white-gold bikini armor: small sculpted breastplate cups, huge pauldrons, gauntlets, bare midriff, high-cut armored bottom under a long sky-blue tabard, thigh-high greaves. Huge kite shield with a sunburst emblem planted at her side, hand on hip. Two feathered wings, simple halo.

ultimate.name: Dawnwall
ultimate.description: Raises the Gate Wardens' wall: shields all allies for 10% of her max HP and grants them +20% DEF for 5 s.

passives.name: Morning Vigil
passives.description: Battle start: gains a shield equal to 25% of her max HP.

heroes.name: Liora
heroes.title: Hymn of Mending
heroes.bio: A temple novice whose lullabies close wounds. She is still learning which songs are safe to sing in battle.
heroes.look: Soft, curvy adult healer angel with long rose-gold hair in a loose side braid over one shoulder, adult makeup and a warm, teasing smile. Strapless cream corset minidress with gold embroidery and a deep cleavage, rose-gold garter straps on white thighhighs, white heels. Leans toward the viewer holding a golden lyre. Two soft white wings, flower-shaped halo.

ultimate.name: Lullaby of Mending
ultimate.description: A lullaby that closes wounds: heals all allies for 240% ATK and grants Regen (40% ATK per second) for 4 s.

passives.name: Hymn of Plenty
passives.description: Battle start: all allies gain +10% max HP.

heroes.name: Uriela
heroes.title: the Sunlance
heroes.bio: A spear maiden of the outer bastions, eager to prove the old stories about her namesake true.
heroes.look: Toned, curvy spear maiden with a high honey-blonde ponytail and a confident grin. Glossy azure-and-white highleg battle leotard with underboob and navel cutouts, gold trim, bare shoulders and back, armored gauntlets and boots, short half-cape. Long golden spear with a sun-shaped blade over her shoulder. Two swept-back wings, thin halo ring.

ultimate.name: Sunlance
ultimate.description: Hurls her blazing spear: 360% ATK to her target and breaks its armor, -40% DEF for 6 s.

heroes.name: Nuriel
heroes.title: Dawn Scout
heroes.bio: A quiet scout who hunts in the moment between night and morning. Says little, misses nothing.
heroes.look: Lean, muscular adult man with short messy pale-gold hair and a white cloth mask over his mouth and nose. Sleeveless hooded sky-blue scout jacket worn open over a bare chest and abs, thin leather chest harness, low-slung crossed belts on fitted black trousers, wrapped forearms. Arms crossed, twin short daggers of white light in reverse grip. Small sharp wings, faint thin halo.

ultimate.name: Daybreak Ambush
ultimate.description: Dives to the back row: strikes the weakest back-row enemy twice for 170% ATK each and Stuns it for 1 s.

heroes.name: Mordessa
heroes.title: the Ember Queen
heroes.bio: Queen of the Ninth Furnace. She lost the war, kept the crown, and has decided the war is not over.
heroes.look: Voluptuous demon queen with large curled black ram horns and a small crown between them, long wavy black hair with crimson ends, sharp eyes and a commanding smirk. Black and crimson armored dress over a black highleg leotard: gold-filigree corset bodice plunging to the navel, one armored shoulder, hip-high skirt slits showing the leotard, garter straps and thigh-high boots. Huge greatsword wreathed in orange flame on her shoulder, hand on hip. Leathery bat wings, thin spaded tail.

ultimate.name: Ninth Furnace
ultimate.description: Brings down the burning greatsword: 320% ATK to her target, 140% ATK to every other enemy, and Burns them all (50% ATK per second) for 4 s.

passives.name: Unending War
passives.description: On kill: restores 20% of her max HP and gains 300 energy.

heroes.name: Brakka
heroes.title: Brimstone Bulwark
heroes.bio: A furnace-golem's grandson with a heart softer than his hide. Loyal to Mordessa, and to anyone who feeds him.
heroes.look: Enormous, heavily muscled male demon with dark red skin, thick short horns and a friendly tusked grin. Shirtless, huge chest and abs crossed by a chain harness, obsidian armor kilt with glowing magma cracks slung low on his hips over black trousers, enormous molten gauntlets. Flexes both arms. No wings; a thick tail.

ultimate.name: Magma Bulwark
ultimate.description: Plants his molten gauntlets: gains a shield of 40% max HP and Taunts all enemies for 5 s.

passives.name: Molten Hide
passives.description: Reflects 20% of damage taken back to the attacker.

heroes.name: Vesper
heroes.title: Mistress of Ember Rain
heroes.bio: A succubus scholar who reads the future in falling ash. Her forecasts are always right, and always fire.
heroes.look: Sultry hourglass succubus scholar with long straight wine-red hair, half-lidded teasing eyes behind thin glasses and small curved horns. Glossy crimson latex catsuit with a heart-shaped cleavage window, opera gloves, high-collared open-front black cape lined in purple. Floating orb of hellfire in one raised hand, adjusting her glasses with the other. Small bat wings, heart-spaded tail.

ultimate.name: Ember Rain
ultimate.description: Forecast: fire. 140% ATK to all enemies and Burns them (50% ATK per second) for 6 s.

passives.name: Ashen Forecast
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 35% chance to Burn the target (30% ATK per second) for 3 s.

heroes.name: Imra
heroes.title: Lantern of Pacts
heroes.bio: An imp shaman who brokers small, fair deals. Mostly fair. Fair-ish.
heroes.look: Mischievous adult imp shaman, lithe and toned with adult curves and makeup, a shaggy shoulder-length mane of orange hair, curved horns, pointed ears and a wild, sharp-toothed grin. Crimson patchwork bandeau bikini with a layered loincloth panel, tribal body paint, bone beads and gold jewelry, sandals. Raises a staff with a hanging lantern holding a green-orange flame. Bat wings, curly tail.

ultimate.name: Lantern Pact
ultimate.description: Strikes a deal with the whole team: all allies +20% ATK for 5 s, and every other ally gains 100 energy.

passives.name: Fair-ish Deal
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 50% chance to Weaken the target: -15% ATK for 3 s.

passives.name: Lantern Light
passives.description: Battle start: all allies gain 150 energy.

heroes.name: Kessa
heroes.title: Ashen Claw
heroes.bio: A hellcat bounty hunter. Twelve contracts, twelve trophies, and one very full scrapbook.
heroes.look: Athletic, curvy cat-like demon with black cat ears AND small horns, short choppy black hair with a red streak, slit-pupil amber eyes and a smug fang smile. Sleek black bodysuit unzipped below the cleavage, red strap harness with o-rings, hip windows, long red scarf, black thigh boots. Twin curved sickles in a low, hip-cocked fighting stance. Long cat tail, no wings.

ultimate.name: Twelfth Contract
ultimate.description: Pounces on the weakest enemy anywhere: 280% ATK, executing it if left below 25% HP (not bosses).

heroes.name: Noctaire
heroes.title: Eclipse Reaper
heroes.bio: Once Heaven's executioner, she cut her own wings rather than carry out one final order. She still keeps the blade.
heroes.look: Tall, slender fallen angel with long silver hair, cold violet eyes and a cracked dark halo tilted on her head. Black highleg corset leotard open at the sides, black lace sleeves, long tattered black drape from the hips, silver buckles and chains, heeled thigh boots. Huge crescent scythe with a violet glow, free hand sweeping her hair. Tattered black feathered wings with violet tips. Melancholic and beautiful.

ultimate.name: Eclipse Harvest
ultimate.description: Dives into the back row with her crescent scythe: 220% ATK to every back-row enemy, executing any left below 30% HP (not bosses).

heroes.name: Orrin
heroes.title: the Chained Oath
heroes.bio: A knight who swore to guard a gate that no longer exists. He guards his friends now, with the same chains.
heroes.look: Stoic, broad male fallen knight with shaggy ash-grey hair and a scar over one eye. Cracked silver armor stripped to one pauldron and gauntlets, bare scarred muscular chest wrapped in broken chains, torn violet cape, black trousers on a low-slung belt with a broken halo hanging from it. Holds a heavy chain-wrapped tower shield. Grey ragged wings.

ultimate.name: Chains of the Oath
ultimate.description: Lashes out with broken chains: 130% ATK to front-row enemies and Stuns them for 2.5 s, then Weakens all enemies (-25% ATK) for 6 s.

heroes.name: Sable
heroes.title: Censer of Dusk
heroes.bio: A fallen nun who still holds services in ruined chapels. Her congregation is mostly ghosts. They come every week.
heroes.look: Gentle, curvy fallen nun with long dark-teal hair under a black-and-violet veil, a silver cross necklace and a sad smile. Skin-tight black habit bodysuit with a cleavage cutout, corset lacing and silver trim, long black tabard panels open at the hips, black thighhighs on garter straps, heels. Swings a silver censer trailing violet smoke. Grey feathered wings, faint dim halo.

ultimate.name: Dusk Requiem
ultimate.description: Swings the censer for the lost: all enemies -50% DEF for 8 s, and all allies heal for 200% ATK.

passives.name: Censer Smoke
passives.description: Basic attacks Expose the target: -25% DEF for 3 s.

passives.name: Vespers
passives.description: Each basic attack also heals the most wounded ally for 70% ATK.

heroes.name: Lucen
heroes.title: Twinfeather Duelist
heroes.bio: One wing white, one wing black. He insists he has not chosen a side. His rapier disagrees, daily.
heroes.look: Flamboyant male duelist with wavy shoulder-length white hair with black tips, half-lidded eyes and a flirtatious smile. Violet and silver coat worn open over a bare toned chest, frilled ascot, tight black leather trousers on a low-slung belt, thigh-high boots, slim rapier, hand on hip. Asymmetric wings: one white feathered, one black feathered. No halo.

ultimate.name: Twinfeather Flurry
ultimate.description: A dazzling flurry: 5 strikes of 85% ATK at random enemies, then +25% SPD for 5 s.

passives.name: Flourish
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 30% chance to strike twice.

heroes.name: Ashra
heroes.title: Witch of Ash
heroes.bio: She burned her own heaven down by accident. Now she studies fire very, very carefully.
heroes.look: Sleepy, sultry ash witch with messy grey hair with violet streaks, half-lidded eyes and a cracked violet halo. Oversized grey witch hat with silver star pins, layered violet robes slipping off her shoulders, strapless cropped tube top, long skirt with high slits over black shorts and a burned hem. Raises one arm lazily, a crooked wand with a violet flame in the other hand. Small grey wings.

ultimate.name: Accidental Inferno
ultimate.description: Oops. 180% ATK to all enemies, +60% damage to enemies below 50% HP.

passives.name: Ash Cloud
passives.description: Her ultimate also Weakens all enemies: -15% ATK for 4 s.
